summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in maintaining essential infrastructure for modern public education, including network infrastructure, digital curriculum, and communications. They argue that preserving E-Rate is essential to avoid budget cuts and maintain connectivity for students and educators. The school district urges the FCC to reject proposals that would sunset or eliminate E-Rate and instead work to strengthen and modernize the program. The IT Director urges protection of the E-Rate program to ensure continued access to connectivity for students and schools.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, districts like Campbellsport School District would have to cut costs in other areas to maintain essential infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Campbellsport School District has received $203,987 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $40,797 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.

claims.argument: The program provides essential connectivity for schools and students
claims.evidence_quote: Our students deserve access to the tools they need to learn and succeed regardless of where they live or their family’s financial circumstances.
